def summarize_scores(scores):
    total = sum(scores)
    avg = total / len(scores)
    return {"count": len(scores), "average": round(avg, 2), "top": max(scores)}

quiz_scores = [78, 84, 91, 88, 95]
report = summarize_scores(quiz_scores)
print(f"Summary -> count={report['count']}, avg={report['average']}, top={report['top']}")
